item.title: Projects
item.description:
Projects

  • Lisp Interpreter — A Lisp interpreter built from scratch with an interactive REPL, S-expression parsing, environment bindings, conditionals, arithmetic, and classic list primitives. C
  • BanterMart — An AI-negotiated marketplace where verified buyers and sellers delegate bargaining to agents, approve deals themselves, and settle payments in USDC. React, Vite, Supabase, Gemini, World ID, MiniKit
  • UofTWebring — Building a unified space for UofT students to gather and showcase their web portfolios. Next.js, Vercel, Supabase, PostgreSQL
  • Collaborative Shopping Cart — Shop collaboratively and never leave an item behind again. React, Flask, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker
  • LooGuessr — A social media geo-guesser game designed for students to learn about their campus. React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB
  • spotify-to-youtube — A tool that converts Spotify playlists to YouTube playlists. Python, Selenium

item.title: Hello World!
item.description:
This is the beginning… hopefully… Edit: nah screw that we’ll make it work

I have always wanted to write, but never really put any effort towards doing so. This will be my first real attempt at blogging and documenting what I am up to, whether that is tech related or just random snippets of my life.

I have always looked up to people who write, formally or informally, and I have grew tremendously from reading the things other people have written. Particularly, Max Bernstein, Michal Pitr, Patrick Collison and so many more people. To those who tune into the subsequent blogs, I hope they can help provide even the slightest insight into something interesting you didn’t know about and make you a fuller person.
